diagnostics.message: module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app registers the webhook URL with the GitHub app via a local-exec provisioner, but it only waits for module.runners:output.webhook, which depends on the API Gateway API, webhook Lambda, role and log group — not on the API wiring. Nothing orders update_app after module.runners.module.webhook:resource.aws_apigatewayv2_route.webhook (and likewise not after the $default stage or aws_lambda_permission.webhook), so the GitHub app can be pointed at the endpoint before POST /webhook is routed and authorized to invoke the Lambda, causing the initial webhook registration/ping against a non-functional endpoint.

module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_s3_object.trigger exists solely to fire the s3:ObjectCreated notification that invokes the syncer Lambda for the initial post-deploy binary sync. The object depends on the Lambda, bucket and notification (which correctly waits on the Lambda permission), but nothing orders it after module.runners.module.runner_binaries:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.syncer (and aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_logging), so the first invocation can run before the Lambda's inline role policies are attached — plus IAM's eventual-consistency delay — and fail with AccessDenied, defeating the one-shot trigger until the next hourly EventBridge run.
